steps: npm run build; launch out/main/index.js with Playwright _electron under xvfb-run (--no-sandbox), clean XDG_CONFIG_HOME (default STANDARD_FIELDS schema)
Stub dialog.showOpenDialog to a temp folder with a copy of tests/fixtures/sample.wav; Open Folder; select alpha.wav
In Artists type 'Artist One' Enter, 'Artist Two' Enter; click Save Tags
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format_tags -of json alpha.wav; dump LIST/INFO sub-chunks
bugs.expected: Artists land in the chunk the schema declares (STANDARD_FIELDS artists.riffChunkId = 'IART') and an ffprobe-based importer sees every artist under one key
bugs.actual: LIST/INFO holds two ISTR sub-chunks, not the schema-declared IART. ffprobe format_tags: artist="Artist One" plus a separate raw key ISTR="Artist Two". music-metadata reads both into common.artists. An importer keyed on ffprobe "artist" sees only the first artist. This is PRE-EXISTING: the standard-prop path (tag.performers, node-taglib-sharp) is not in A's diff. It is not a round-2 regression. It is a T-1 tag-contract input (K-4 field -> chunk, needs a D-ID).
